consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of TX-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-9001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. TX-9001 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 13 May 2011 a hazard report was recorded on TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
